about: What an installer installs, per component. Paths are relative to the BO3 folder and are where sync.sh puts each file: shaders/ into both shader sets, deps/<set>/ into its own set, techsets/ into both techset sets. A * matches any run of characters, slashes included. Every component shares the release version (VERSION). release.ps1 checks that every installed file belongs to exactly one component, then writes blak-shaders.json into the zip with the version and each file's path, size and SHA-256.

components.name: Shared shader headers
components.summary: The transforms, skinning, constant buffers and forward lighting every Blak shader includes. Comes with any shader that needs it.

components.name: Parallax
components.summary: lit_advanced_fullspec_parallax: parallax occlusion mapping on world geometry and models. Needs no tool patches.

components.name: Tessellation
components.summary: Surfaces that tessellate and displace up close (parallax, two-layer and 2-4 layer blends) and the decals that follow them.

requires.why: the stock linker drops tessellated draws without it; Dragon or the bo3-mt-patches linker plugin provides it
bullets hit the flat patch, not the displaced surface, without it

recommends.why: tessellated surfaces don't draw in Radiant and APE without TessTopology
spacing, near and far as material settings need Dragon to link the map

components.name: Frosted glass
components.summary: See-through glass and polymer for viewmodel parts and world brushes. Needs no tool patches.

recommends.why: APE lights it from flat grey, with no see-through
